$comment: Real activations for nonpixel-runner.mjs. Transient states use real network transitions plus real typing/clicks; nothing is mocked or injected.

app.error.route.note: Real server 400 (tags over 50 chars) rendered by the search error card. An offline transition does NOT reach the error card: React Query pauses the query offline and the page shows the empty 'No resources match' state (recorded as a finding).

app.system.toast.note: Real favourite mutation on the owned QA identity (favourites cascade with the user at teardown); the success toast is the audited state.

app.system.error.unverified: ErrorPage renders only when the corpus fetch fails on a corpus route. Going offline before that navigation also fails the lazy ErrorPage chunk, which trips the one-shot chunk reload guard and replaces the page with the browser's offline document. No real, non-injected activation reaches ErrorPage itself; the offline search error card (app.error.route) and the natural 404 (app.system.not-found) cover the error-state pattern.
